definitions: Rest on or near the surface of a liquid without sinking.
Move or be carried slowly by a current of air or water.
Put forward a plan or an idea for consideration.
Allow a country's currency to fluctuate in value against other currencies on the international market.
Start a company or sell shares in an existing company.
examples: The boat will float on the water.
A feather began to float in the air.
They decided to float the idea at the meeting.
The government decided to float the pound.
The company plans to float on the stock market next year.
